To: Wilson Jones <wjones@atterleyappliances.com>
From: Javi Preston <javipreston@yukoandjavisplace.com>
Date: April 22
Subject: Appliance delivery
Dear Mr. Jones:
I am sending this e-mail to 135. Atterley Appliances for your delivery service. It was excellent
and exceeded my 136. in every way. My restaurant, Yuko and Javi's Place, is housed in a very
old building with no elevator. The chest freezer I ordered from Atterley Appliances had to be
delivered to the building's top floor. "137 It took careful maneuvering to avoid damaging the
stairway walls on the way up. Thanks to the team's patience and attention to detail, the new
freezer was installed with no damage to the 138. structure. Many thanks to Atterley Appliances
for your quality service.
Yours truly,
Javi Preston
context.passage_translation:
收件人：Wilson Jones <wjones@atterleyappliances.com>
发件人：Javi Preston <javipreston@yukoandjavisplace.com>
日期：4月22日
主题：家电配送

尊敬的 Jones 先生：
我写这封电子邮件是为了 135. 表扬 Atterley Appliances 的配送服务。服务非常出色，在各个方面都超出了我的 136. 预期。我的餐厅 Yuko and Javi's Place 位于一栋非常老旧且没有电梯的建筑里。我从 Atterley Appliances 订购的卧式冰柜必须送到大楼顶层。137. ____ 在搬上楼的过程中，工作人员必须小心挪动，才能避免损坏楼梯间的墙壁。多亏配送团队耐心细致，新冰柜顺利安装完成，且没有对这座 138. 历史悠久的建筑造成任何损坏。非常感谢 Atterley Appliances 提供的优质服务。

谨致敬意！
Javi Preston
